subject.title: [Feature]: Add native mobile Automations management parity

question: Should native mobile clients adopt the proposed focused Automations-management subset, and should iOS parity plus cross-platform naming and discovery be delivered as one initiative?
rationale: The Gateway contracts already exist, but maintainers must choose how much Control UI functionality belongs in first-party phone experiences and how to sequence the cross-platform work.

options.title: Sponsor focused native parity
options.body: Approve the proposed phone-appropriate subset, preserving the Control UI as the advanced authoring surface and allowing implementation to be staged by platform.

options.title: Limit to discovery improvements
options.body: Rename the surfaces and add search and status filtering now, while deferring additional iOS mutation and history workflows.

options.title: Retain minimal mobile controls
options.body: Keep native clients limited to basic run and enable or pause actions and direct operators to the Control UI for management.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused native parity
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed phone-appropriate subset, preserving the Control UI as the advanced authoring surface and allowing implementation to be staged by platform.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and already frames the intended product boundary and platform tradeoffs.
